subject.title: Feature: Support custom anthropic_beta flags in Bedrock model config

question: Should Bedrock expose a broad `additionalModelRequestFields` or `providerFields` passthrough, a narrower typed `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` option, or no user-configurable beta flags?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but any fix creates a user-facing provider config contract and repository policy treats new provider/config surfaces as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
options.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that safely validates and merges request fields, including `anthropic_beta`, without moving provider-specific policy into core.

options.title: Add only a narrow beta option
options.body: Support a typed Bedrock `anthropicBeta` or long-context option for Claude while avoiding a general Converse body passthrough.

options.title: Decline custom betas
options.body: Keep Bedrock request shaping internal and require first-class provider support for each beta feature instead of user-configurable request fields.

recommendation.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
recommendation.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that safely validates and merges request fields, including `anthropic_beta`, without moving provider-specific policy into core.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the most product-policy-shaped owner choice among the likely owners because it affects provider config compatibility and the plugin/core boundary.
